domain_notes: compute_sales_tax quantizes the computed tax to cents using ROUND_HALF_EVEN, which is the entire requirement. Both existing tests use inputs that never land on a half-cent tie (100.00 at 8% = 8.00 exactly; 50.00 at 0% = 0.00), so the rounding mode is never distinguished from any other mode.
rationale: Selected compute_sales_tax because the ROUND_HALF_EVEN quantize is the sole enforcement and no test lands on a half-cent tie that would distinguish the rounding mode.
